name: WayriCAD PDN and Decoupling Planner
description: Audit power-rail topology and local decoupling placement from PCB geometry.
description_full: Uses configurable rail, ground, capacitor, load, and regulator conventions to locate supply pins without nearby rail-to-ground capacitors. Results are sortable, cross-selectable, and exportable. It is a placement/topology screen rather than an AC impedance, transient, or electromagnetic PDN solver.
